sections.h2: All nine Enneagram types at a glance (plus how they steer AI).
sections.html:
Whereas MBTI describes cognitive style and DISC describes workplace pace, the Enneagram centers on core motivation—what you optimize for and what creates friction under stress. Ready to take the assessment first? Open the free 36-item Enneagram test →

sections.h2: How wings (5w4 vs 5w6) and tied scores actually work.
sections.html:
Two scoring details separate transparent open instruments from black-box personality quizzes:

  • Adjacent wings only: In Enneagram theory, your wing is one of the two types immediately next to your core type on the circle (wrapping 9 ↔ 1). If your top score is Type 5 (18/20), our scorer compares Type 4 vs. Type 6—never a non-adjacent runner-up like Type 8. If Type 4 scores 15 and Type 6 scores 13, your profile is 5w4; if 4 and 6 tie, no wing is forced.
  • Why ties should never be hidden: With 4 Likert items (1–5) per type, two types frequently tie at the top (for example, Type 1 and Type 5 both scoring 17/20). Silently breaking ties by picking the lower number invents certainty the items didn't measure. Our test runner and Enneagram Scoring Playground surface all tied leaders so you can read both profiles and choose deliberately.

sections.h2: Open-source transparency: inspect every item and line of code.
sections.html:
Nothing in the test is hidden on a backend server:

  • Browser-only privacy: Answers live temporarily in your tab's memory (and optional localStorage draft while in progress) and are cleared on completion.
  • Auditable spec & developer starter: You can read all 36 items in plain Markdown at /tests/enneagram.md, review licensing and provenance in our open-source Enneagram developer guide, or download a runnable nine-group scorer in React + TypeScript.

sections.h2: Try an Enneagram-informed AI communication block.
sections.html:
Here is a condensed Type 5 (Investigator) starter block—or browse copy-paste blocks for all nine types in Enneagram AI prompts for all 9 types:

## Working with me (Enneagram Type 5 — First-Principles & Autonomous) - Explain the underlying mechanism or model, not just a surface recipe. - Lead with substance; skip conversational warm-ups, praise, and motivational filler. - Separate verified facts from inference and flag material uncertainty explicitly. - Give me space to weigh tradeoffs before pushing for premature closure. - Challenge flawed assumptions in my framing with direct evidence.

faq.q: Is the AgentTune Enneagram test completely free with no email required?
faq.a: Yes. All 36 questions are scored locally in your web browser in about 5 minutes with no email address, account creation, or paid unlock.

faq.q: How many questions are on this free Enneagram test?
faq.a: 36 Likert-scale questions (4 items for each of the 9 Enneagram types, rated 1 to 5 from Disagree to Agree), adapted from the Open Enneagram of Personality Scales (OEPS).

faq.q: What if my top two Enneagram types tie?
faq.a: Instead of secretly picking one type by tie-breaker order, the test reports all nine totals (4–20) and links the communication guides for every tied leader so you can decide which motivation actually fits you.

faq.q: Can I use this Enneagram test to diagnose mental health or screen job applicants?
faq.a: No. Like all open personality questionnaires on AgentTune, it is an educational self-reflection tool for exploring personal communication preferences—never a clinical diagnosis or employment screening test.
